metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the sci-paper scientific writing + review + ideation plugin.

plugins.name: sci-paper
plugins.description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). v0.12 adds `/paper` top-level standard "Structural Updates · Forward Narrative": every update / correction must rewrite the paper to its current final state; never leave "tried A, then switched to B" patch-style residue. Forms the writing-time dual of `paper-review` §2.O (update-not-accumulate). v0.11 fixes the `final-review` nested-sub-agent bug (MPR promoted to main-agent §3.6, paper-review gains `--no-isolated-mpr`), adds R. Glossary dimension to paper-review and §2.0 glossary grill prelude to brainstorm (borrowed from mattpocock-skills:grill-with-docs), and rewrites 6 descriptions with explicit `Use when …` triggers (mattpocock-skills:write-a-skill convention). v0.10 final-review 5-skill orchestrator + paper-review P+Q, v0.9 paper-attack-tree, v0.8 mainline, v0.7 paper-review N+O, v0.6 paper-review v3, v0.5 brainstorm carry over.
